title: Carlyle finalises $2.8bn acquisition of majority stake in MAI Capital
title_zh: 凯雷完成 28 亿美元收购 MAI Capital 多数股权
summary: The existing management of MAI remains in place, with the business maintaining operational independence.
summary_zh: MAI 现有管理层保持不变，业务保持运营独立性。

title: Oil prices fall on Iran deal; S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise
title_zh: 伊朗协议导致油价下跌；标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货上涨
summary: U.S. stock futures rose Tuesday as chip stocks extended a recovery from last week's selloff, while crude oil fell on Trump's Iran deal comments
summary_zh: 美国股指期货周二上涨，芯片股延续了上周抛售的复苏势头，而原油则因特朗普的伊朗协议言论而下跌

title: Is Innodata's 162% Rally Over the Past Month Hype or the Real Deal?
title_zh: Innodata 过去一个月上涨 162% 是炒作还是真实情况？
summary: Innodata is a behind-the-scenes artificial intelligence (AI) play that has quietly crushed most of the leaders.
summary_zh: Innodata是一场幕后人工智能（AI）剧，已经悄然碾压了大部分领先者。

title: Intel Stock Gains. What a New Deal Means for Its Chip-Manufacturing Plans.
title_zh: 英特尔股票上涨。新政对其芯片制造计划意味着什么。
summary: FEATURE   Intel shares were rising early Tuesday. A newly expanded deal with Cadence Design Systems looks like a sign of confidence in Intel’s next-generation chip-manufacturing process.  Intel shares were up 1.
summary_zh: 周二早些时候，英特尔股价上涨。与 Cadence Design Systems 最新扩大的交易看起来像是对英特尔下一代芯片制造工艺充满信心的标志。  英特尔股价上涨1.

title: Google's $920 Million‑a‑Month Deal Could Supercharge the SpaceX IPO
title_zh: 谷歌每月 9.2 亿美元的交易可能会加速 SpaceX 的 IPO
summary: An already interesting IPO story just became even more intriguing.
summary_zh: 本来就很有趣的 IPO 故事变得更加有趣。
